The sentence that now decides it: "Unless a call's result is bound to a name, each of its arguments is a name or a short literal: a map, struct or keyword list that would span several lines is built first under a name that says what it is, one field per line, with a blank line between multi-line statements." with "A call whose result is bound to a name may take its options inline".
